mapper.insert: INSERT INTO federation_connection (idp_id, name, protocol, enabled, issuer, saml_sso_url, saml_cert, oidc_authorize_url, oidc_token_url, oidc_jwks_url, client_id, client_secret, scopes, subject_claim, name_claim, email_claim, allowed_tenants, sort_order) VALUES (#{idpId}, #{name}, #{protocol}, #{enabled}, #{issuer}, #{samlSsoUrl}, #{samlCert}, #{oidcAuthorizeUrl}, #{oidcTokenUrl}, #{oidcJwksUrl}, #{clientId}, #{clientSecret}, #{scopes}, #{subjectClaim}, #{nameClaim}, #{emailClaim}, #{allowedTenants}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE federation_connection SET name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, issuer = #{issuer}, saml_sso_url = #{samlSsoUrl}, saml_cert = #{samlCert}, oidc_authorize_url = #{oidcAuthorizeUrl}, oidc_token_url = #{oidcTokenUrl}, oidc_jwks_url = #{oidcJwksUrl}, client_id = #{clientId}, client_secret = #{clientSecret}, scopes = #{scopes}, subject_claim = #{subjectClaim}, name_claim = #{nameClaim}, email_claim = #{emailClaim}, allowed_tenants = #{allowedTenants}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
